reception: EDDI's own citation record is modest and consists mostly of list membership: it appears in related-work sections of debugging, instrumentation, and tracing papers as the demonstration that software watchpoints can scale far beyond the hardware debug registers. A handful of works engage more directly — the work on lightweight memory tracing differentiates its design from EDDI's, and PinADX discusses it in detail — but no external system in the record builds on the tool itself. What circulates is the result: papers from time-travel debugging to undefined-value detection cite the million-watchpoint figure as the reference point for instrumentation-based monitoring at scale.
